verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents official REST API client libraries for JavaScript, PHP, Python and Ruby. It also supports extension development through hook-based customization and extension UX guidelines with Storybook support. A marketplace of free and paid extensions exists as a distribution channel, but the evidence never describes a developer submission or review process, and no extension scaffolding tool is shown. Missing for 10: official extension scaffolding/generator tooling, a documented marketplace submission and review process for developers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extension developer workflow.
